title: uraria campanulata
intro: Uraria campanulata, commonly known as "Hemionga" or "Kapur kachri," is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Uraria campanulata include its ability to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
